review: Thrown explosive/incendiary rows visually reviewed; preparation and cloud rules, quality, electronic packages, ammunition variants and optional malfunctions enumerated. Firearm profiles are indexed in separate ledgers; executable integration remains pending.

Hand-thrown devices use throwing, default dexterity minus three or dropping minus four. Do not use thrown-weapon skill defaults merely because an explosive is a weapon.

Lighting a prepared fuse takes one ready action, or five if the fuse must first be inserted. Rain or other unsuitable conditions can prevent lighting. Powder fuse length determines three-to-five-second delay; incendiary bottles break on impact. Define exact arming timestamp and selected fuse duration before commitment.

Pin-type grenades require one ready action to draw and another to pull the pin, then detonate after the item specified two/four-second delay. Own the armed item and expiry independently of the actor action queue, including transfer/drop, rollback and save continuation.
The incendiary bottle uses B411 fuel-fire and breaking-container rules, not an invented blast damage roll. Commit fuel ignition, broken container, actual impact and persistent burning once.

Chemical grenade produces a two-yard-radius cloud lasting about eighty seconds under ordinary conditions. Author defines chemical and environmental dispersal; special agents can change price/legality. Reuse actual poison exposure rules and per-subject clocks; the generic catalogue entry alone is not a completed substance effect.

Sensory grenade is both vision/hearing-based within ten yards. Protected hearing and protected vision each add five to health resistance. Failure stuns, with health-minus-five recovery checks every turn; it also creates smoke. Integrate sense-channel blocking and smoke geometry rather than applying an unconditional radius stun.

Fine blowpipes/bows/crossbows cost four times list and increase half-damage and maximum ranges by twenty percent. Thrown items and arrows/bolts use melee quality rules. Distinguish projectile quality damage from launcher quality range; do not apply both bonuses to both fields.

At technology three-plus, armor-piercing arrow/bolt tips replace impaling with ordinary piercing and add armor divisor two, without price/mass change. Validate compatibility and combine material/quality effects explicitly rather than retaining impaling wound multiplication.

Powered firearms include projectile, rocket and beam weapons independent of muscle strength. Campaign technology sets availability; this does not erase minimum-strength handling, speculative-physics permissions or specific item technology.

Integrated electronic weapon package is optional at technology eight for five hundred extra, standard at nine-plus without surcharge. Includes a laser aiming aid, +1 repair/malfunction-fix skill, and authorized-user access control. Built-in optical sights can link to a worn head-up display using B548 targeting rules. Keep each component availability and operation distinct.

Unauthorized users cannot fire a weapon with active electronic access restrictions. Author defines individual/unit authorization and configuration actions. This is an in-world equipment permission, not real account authentication; it must persist with the item and be checked before resource/randomness commitment.

Table-marked rocket handgun damage is divided by three at one-to-two yards and two at three-to-ten yards because of acceleration. Marked civilian conversions set rate three, reduce cost twenty-five percent and increase legality class by one. Apply only to eligible profiles, preserving other statistics.

A full ordinary ammunition reload costs twenty times its listed mass in pounds. One-pound reload costs twenty. Single-shot weapon weight semantics remain distinct from loaded multi-shot items; charge actual purchased ammunition rather than a free reload per weapon action.

Expanding ammunition at technology six-plus advances piercing size one step (small to ordinary, ordinary to large, large to huge) and adds armor divisor one half. Not available for already-huge piercing; cost and legality unchanged. Listed application excludes shotguns, electromagnetic guns and dart rifles.

Hard-core ammunition at technology seven-plus adds armor divisor two. Below twenty-millimeter caliber, reduce piercing size one step down to small; small remains small. Costs double ordinary and legality class is two. Exactly twenty millimeters does not take the below-caliber reduction. Excluded weapon classes remain ineligible.

A dart firearm injects the selected substance only after penetration. Listed sedative follow-up is health minus three, failure unconscious for minutes equal to failure margin. This is a game substance effect tied to a specific item mode, not an automatic effect for every dart.

Combined rifle/launcher has a separately specified twenty-five-millimeter launch mode at B281. Share one physical host and included mass/price while retaining independent ammunition, readiness and attack modes. Do not count the integrated launcher as a second full purchase.

Optional malfunction rule triggers when raw attack roll is at least the weapon malfunction threshold. Baselines by technology: three gives twelve, four fourteen, five sixteen, six-plus seventeen. Item reliability, quality and maintenance can alter it. Campaign must explicitly enable this rule; route results through B407 rather than silently replacing ordinary critical outcomes.
